info.name: Payroll Breakdown
info.description:
Day-by-day payroll breakdown APIs.

Base URL: {{base_url}}
All routes are scoped under: /api/companies/:company_id/payrolls

Auth: Bearer token via Authorization header (verifyToken middleware)
Role: isManager minimum for GET, isAdmin for mutations

request.description:
Returns a day-by-day salary breakdown for a single payroll record.

Each day shows:
- day_type: present | absent | holiday | week_off | paid_leave | half_day_leave | unpaid_leave | half_day | comp_off | sandwich
- payable_amount: salary earned for that day
- deduction_amount: salary deducted for that day
- net_day_amount: payable + overtime for that day
- is_sandwich: true if the day was caught by the sandwich leave rule

item.name: 2. Get Breakdown — All Employees in Period

request.description:
Returns daily breakdowns for every employee in the given payroll period.

Employees with errors (missing salary structure, DB issues) are returned in the `failed` array — other employees still succeed.

Useful for the admin review screen before approving/paying payroll.

request.description: Token belongs to a role below isManager (e.g. a regular employee). The authorizeRoles middleware rejects.
company_id in the URL does not match the company_id in the verified token — validateTenant rejects.

# day_type field values

| day_type        | Deduction? | Description |
|-----------------|------------|-------------|
| `present`       | ❌         | Employee checked in/out with sufficient hours |
| `half_day`      | ✅ 0.5×    | Checked in but total_hours < shift.half_day_hours |
| `absent`        | ✅ 1×      | No attendance record on a working day |
| `holiday`       | ❌         | Company-declared or public holiday — fully paid |
| `week_off`      | ❌         | Day not in shift working days (e.g. Sat/Sun) — fully paid |
| `paid_leave`    | ❌         | Approved leave where leave_type.is_paid = true |
| `half_day_leave`| ❌         | Approved half-day paid leave |
| `unpaid_leave`  | ✅ 1×      | Approved leave where leave_type.is_paid = false |
| `comp_off`      | ❌         | Compensatory off — treated same as week_off |
| `sandwich`      | ✅ 1×      | Week-off/holiday between two deductible days — sandwich leave rule applied |

# is_sandwich flag
When `is_sandwich: true`, the day was originally a `week_off`, `holiday`, or `comp_off` but fell between two consecutive deductible days (absent/unpaid_leave), so the sandwich rule converts it to a deductible day.

# pay_fraction vs deduct_fraction
- `pay_fraction`: portion of per_day_salary the employee earns (0, 0.5, or 1)
- `deduct_fraction`: portion deducted (0, 0.5, or 1)
- For a normal present day: pay=1, deduct=0
- For half-day: pay=0.5, deduct=0.5
- For absent/unpaid: pay=0, deduct=1

# net_day_amount
= payable_amount + overtime_amount

# Summary net_salary formula
gross_salary − total_deduction + total_overtime_amt
